test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most suitable word.

A disconsolate Arjun ______ his way back down the mountain.
solution:
The correct answer is '**makes**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb '**disconsolate**' means unable to be comforted or cheered up. (असंतोषजनक)

 
 
• **Example**: The **disconsolate **child cried for hours after losing his favourite toy.
 
 
 
• The correct word, '**makes**,' in this context means to proceed, move or go. (बनाना or चलना)
 
 
• **Example**: He **makes **his way through the crowded market with ease.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct word is '**makes**.'

Therefore, the correct answer is “**Option 4**”.

 

**Correct Sentence**: *'A disconsolate Arjun **makes__** his way back down the mountain.'*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Absconds **means to leave hurriedly and secretly, typically to escape from custody or avoid arrest. (भाग जाना)

 
 
• **Example**: The thief **absconds **with the stolen jewels.
 
 
 
• **Elopes **means to run away secretly in order to get married, especially without parental consent. (भगकर शादी करना)
 
 
• **Example**: The young couple **elopes **due to their families' disapproval of their relationship.
 
 
 
• **Deserts **means to abandon (a person, cause, or organization) in a way considered disloyal or treacherous. (त्याग देना)
 
 
• **Example**: He **deserts **his friends in their time of need.

The correct answer is 'Option 3' </stro
